sections.title: Fire, the child and the flower
sections.line: Crowley on the destruction of the world by Fire, the child Horus born of the marriage, and the letter Shin in a form suggestive of a flower (pdf p107, p108).

quotes.quote: The card therefore represented the destruction of the world by Fire.
As a result of the marriage of these two, the child Horus is born.
At the bottom of the card we see the letter Shin itself in a form suggestive of a flower;
